item.name: Mysterious Fertilizer
item.effect: Adds 2 random mutations to a growing tree's fruit.
item.bestUse: Spend it on a growing tree when you want cheap extra mutation rolls.
item.cardSummary: A 20 Token fertilizer that adds two random mutations while the tree is still growing.

item.name: Growth Fertilizer
item.effect: Cuts the remaining growth time on one plot by 50%.
item.bestUse: Use it when a tree you care about still has a long wait left.
item.cardSummary: A 100 Token fertilizer that halves whatever growth time is left on one plot.

item.name: Cleansing Fertilizer
item.effect: Removes 1 random mutation from a growing tree.
item.bestUse: Use it to strip a bad mutation before you harvest or replant.
item.cardSummary: A 500 Token fertilizer that removes one random mutation from a growing tree.

item.name: Ascendant Fertilizer
item.effect: Adds 1 guaranteed good mutation to a growing tree's fruit.
item.bestUse: Save it for a tree you want a guaranteed positive mutation on after your first Ascension.
item.cardSummary: A 77,777 Token fertilizer that adds one guaranteed good mutation. The shop hides it until your first Ascension.

item.name: Irrigation Kit
item.effect: Permanently doubles growth speed on one plot.
item.bestUse: Buy this first on a plot you plan to keep using.
item.cardSummary: A 500 Token plot upgrade that permanently doubles growth speed on that one plot.

item.name: Soil Enricher
item.effect: Permanently doubles growth speed on one plot again.
item.bestUse: Use it after Irrigation Kit on the same plot for a second permanent speed doubling.
item.cardSummary: A 5,000 Token plot upgrade that permanently doubles growth speed again on one plot.

item.name: Enriched Uranium
item.effect: Guarantees +2 mutations for every tree grown on one plot.
item.bestUse: Put this on a plot you already luck-boosted if you want extra mutations on every tree there.
item.cardSummary: A 10,000 Token plot upgrade that adds two mutations to every tree grown on that plot.

item.name: Lucky Clovers
item.effect: Permanently raises the chance of rarer mutations on one plot.
item.bestUse: Buy this first on a plot you plan to mutate, before Enriched Uranium or cheap fertilizer spam.
item.cardSummary: A 20,000 Token plot upgrade that permanently raises rarer-mutation luck on that one plot.
